newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble virtually unchanged vs dollar, credits up.
newsitem.headline: Rouble virtually unchanged vs dollar, credits up.

text.p: The rouble eased on Tuesday from Monday's levels despite a rise in overnight rouble credit rates, with rouble funds in demand for Wednesday's Treasury bill auctions, traders said.
rouble/dollar Feb 11 midday Feb 11 early Feb 10 close
Dealers said steady demand for dollars was balancing demand for roubles ahead of the T-bill sale.

"The market is very quiet and well-balanced. Expensive rouble funds do not allow the dollar to rise and cannot prop the rouble up against the dollar either as people are buying dollars as usual," said a trader with a major Moscow bank.
The Finance Ministry will offer 4.5 trillion roubles in 196-day GKO discount Treasury bills (series 22071) and seven trillion roubles in 287-day T-bills (series 22072) on Wednesday.
